reason: Audit decision is repair: the candidate for cycle 33563418289 did NOT fix the V2-07 release blocker. The only delta vs pristine accepted tree (d717169) is release-log.txt (the 2240-line failed-run log from Actions run 33552750352); no product code, script, or workflow was modified. The root cause is confirmed: android-emulator-runner executes each script: line as a separate sh -c process, so the $package shell variable set on line 1 does not persist to line 3 where smoke-android-apk.sh is invoked with an empty $2, causing abort on ${2:?package}. The fix requires inlining the package value per line in the emulator script block (or making the smoke script fall back to app.json when $2 is empty). Both fixes are in the protected .github/** surface. The previous Builder scope ('Protected .github control-plane files remain trusted-shell owned') prevented the Builder from applying the fix. Director extends the Builder scope to explicitly include .github/workflows/chorescore-v2-factory.yml release job emulator script block and .github/scripts/smoke-android-apk.sh for this targeted release-script repair only. V2-07 remains active. Builder remains enabled. Next cycle must produce a candidate that actually fixes the release blocker; the trusted release shell alone attests V2-07 completion.
